falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4200 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern expected a higher low formation; a break below 4200 would violate the structural support level that pattern established, proving this is not a comparable bottoming process but rather a breakdown into a deeper correction

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom featured VIX peaking near 28 and rapidly mean-reverting; sustained VIX above 35 would indicate panic-driven liquidation rather than the orderly accumulation the pattern requires, invalidating the bottom formation thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts further to -75 basis points or wider
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom coincided with yield curve steepening from deeply inverted levels; further inversion would signal deteriorating growth expectations and financial stress, contradicting the cyclical recovery conditions embedded in the pattern match
